name: Unifique Telecomunicações S.A.
summary: Unifique Telecomunicações S.A. operates as a telecommunications provider based in Brazil, offering a diverse portfolio of communication and digital services. Its offerings include internet access, traditional fixed-line telephone services, and various pay-television options such as satellite, cable, and microwave TV. The company also delivers SCM multimedia communications, facilitating access to communication networks, digital portals, content, and internet information services. Additionally, Unifique provides essential digital infrastructure services like data storage, data hosting, data processing, application management, and general internet hosting. Founded in 1997, the company's main office is located in Timbo, Brazil.
